classification.difficultyReason: Interpret the painted outside as the cylinder wall and hemisphere curved surface, excluding the ground-facing base and internal join, then convert diameter to radius and add the two areas.

content.prompt:
A grain silo is made up of a cylinder with a hemisphere (half a sphere) on top.

The outside of the silo is to be painted. What is the area to be painted, to 1 decimal place?

spec.description: Unshaded upright cylinder with an upper hemispherical cap, a shared circular join and a centre marker. Front join and base arcs are solid; rear arcs are dashed. Dimension arrows show the complete diameter beneath the base and cylinder height from base level to join level. This composite uses free-form TikZ and requires independent curved-solid geometry review.
spec.mathematics: Cylinder and hemisphere share radius 24 m. Cylinder height is 30 m. The painted exterior consists of the cylinder's curved surface and the hemisphere's curved surface; the shared join and ground-facing base are excluded.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens 48 m and 30 m are visible.

answer.worked:
The base rests on the ground, and the circular join is internal.

$\begin{aligned}r&=\frac{48}{2}=24\text{ m}\\A_{\text{cylinder}}&=2\pi rh\\&=2\pi(24)(30)=1440\pi\text{ m}^2\\A_{\text{hemisphere}}&=\frac12\times4\pi r^2\\&=2\pi(24)^2=1152\pi\text{ m}^2\\A_{\text{painted}}&=1440\pi+1152\pi\\&=2592\pi\\&\approx8143.0\text{ m}^2\end{aligned}$
